profile.Name: Chad
profile.Personality: Cocky and loud about his own strength, though he denies being a braggart. He admits without shame that he ran from a fight, saying he is no Tinfist.
profile.Backstory: He set out for the Ashlands and got halfway, through the beak nests, before trouble with the pit gangs turned him back. He punched a Beak Thing in the nose and fled east when the herd came after him. Now he is resting in Flats Lagoon and says he will be trained up and ready again soon.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Brash slang such as 'knuckle dustwich' and 'no biggies'; calls others 'rookie' and 'chump'.
